notes.erector_note: Extra height agreed verbally on site.

deciding.design_conformity: Variation is null. Height 12.4 m exceeds the 12.0 m maximum and ties are 15 against 20 required. The verbal agreement in the erector note is not an approval.
deciding.handover_decision: The tie test passes and the structure has the designed 6 lifts, which favours release. The unapproved departures and the open defect across all lifts make accept_restricted plausible.
deciding.limiting_issue: The unapproved tie and height departures point to design_departure. The passing tie test and matching lift count leave none_found a modest alternative.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Ties 15 against 20 required is exactly 25%, on the boundary of levels 2 and 3. Height is 3.3% over.
deciding.releasable_share: The open loose boards defect covers lifts 1-6, so no lift is clearly releasable (level 0). The defect is minor and could be rectified per lift, so level 1 is also plausible.
